1. In local spacetime theories, every field equation states that a tensor vanishes.
2. A tensor vanishes exactly when the components of that tensor vanish in every coordinate system.
3. Local spacetime theories are spacetime theories.
4. Diffeomorphism carry-along is a tensor transport.
5. Diffeomorphism carry-along preserves components in corresponding coordinate systems.
6. If X is a tensor transport and X preserves components in corresponding coordinate systems and a tensor vanishes exactly when the components of that tensor vanish in every coordinate system, then X preserves tensor vanishing.
7. Therefore, diffeomorphism carry-along preserves tensor vanishing. [2,4,5,6]
8. If X are spacetime theories and in X every field equation states that a tensor vanishes and diffeomorphism carry-along preserves tensor vanishing, then carrying a model's tensors along by a diffeomorphism preserves the field equations of X.
9. Therefore, carrying a model's tensors along by a diffeomorphism preserves the field equations of local spacetime theories. [1,3,7,8]
10. The completeness condition of local spacetime theories states that every tuple of the required form that satisfies the field equations is a model of the theory.
11. Carrying every field of a model of local spacetime theories along by any diffeomorphism yields a tuple of the required form.
12. If X are spacetime theories and carrying a model's tensors along by a diffeomorphism preserves the field equations of X and carrying every field of a model of X along by any diffeomorphism yields a tuple of the required form and the completeness condition of X states that every tuple of the required form that satisfies the field equations is a model of the theory, then carrying every field of a model of X along by any diffeomorphism yields another model of the same theory.
13. Therefore, carrying every field of a model of local spacetime theories along by any diffeomorphism yields another model of the same theory. [3,9,10,11,12]
